DroidBridge uses dynamically linked libmtp and libusb. This archive contains
the corresponding library sources. Extract both archives, apply macOS.patch
with patch -p1, then run bash build-libs.sh arm64 x86_64 with Apple Command
Line Tools. The outputs are vendor-<architecture>/lib/*.dylib. The
application loads the libraries from Contents/Frameworks. The two upstream
license texts are in the source archives and Contents/Resources.
